sentences.text: Respond  Through: Ms. Shubhi Gupta, APP with W/SI  Varsha and SI Sanjay Kumar, PS-  Mehrauli.

Mr. Vishal Singh, Adv. for R2.
 R2 through VC.

CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVINDER DUDEJA  ORDER % 09.05.2025 1.
This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No.648/2013 under Section 406,498A,34 IPC registered at PS-Mehrauli.
2. Respondent no.2 appearing through VC states that she has no objection, in case, the FIR is quashed.
However, she states that she wants visitation rights to meet her daughter who is stated to be in custody of petitioner.
3. The learned counsel for petitioner states that petitioner has no objection regards the same.
4. Both parties to file MoU in this regard within a week.

5. List before the Joint Registrar for recording of statement of parties on 21.05.2025.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J MAY 9, 2025 Sky/ia
